projects.name: Damac Lagoon Views - Damac Lagoons
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of Aqua-themed apartment complex, named Damac Lagoon Views within the upcoming Damac Lagoons master community in Dubai. The Damac Lagoon Views will comprise one- and two-bedroom apartments spanning across ground plus six floors, complemented by various amenities that align with the community's Mediterranean theme.

Residents will have the chance to enjoy an array of relaxation and recreational activities. There will be beauty hills for sunbathing on small green mounds, a honey bar featuring wellness products, strategically placed hammocks over the lagoons, an outdoor spa, and an aqua boho lounge.

An olive tree garden will serve as an enchanting wedding venue amid a cozy event space, while the community's focal point will be the Flamenco Gardens concert stage. The project will feature a unique aqua opera school pavilion and a volcanic stone park. A beach club, glow lounge, board games pavilion, and a dedicated kids area will round out the entertainment offerings at Lagoon Views.

The gastronomy hub will provide diverse food and beverage experiences, including a tapas lounge, a pool bar, and a sunset beach bar. In harmony with the water theme of Damac Lagoons, the new project will captivate with its Lagoon Rain Party Zone and an innovative aquatic party venue. Fitness enthusiasts can look forward to an aqua gym equipped with a running track.

Damac Lagoon Views - Damac Lagoons is a greenfield mid rise (4 - 14) project in Dubai, valued at USD 200.0 million, at under construction (7.0 percent complete). Developed by Damac Crescent Properties Llc,Damac Properties Co. Llc. Lead consultant Jouzy Consulting Engineers (Axianta International); MEP consultant Jouzy Consulting Engineers (Axianta International). No contractor appointed. Completion date not recorded in the source workbook.

The amenities will feature balconies, barbecue areas, calisthenics equipment, a children's pool, a climbing wall, a co-working space, a dog park, a fitness center, a gaming zone, jogging trails, a lap pool, a library, an outdoor cinema, restaurants, sports courts, steam and sauna rooms, yoga and meditation spaces, and a zen garden. projects.name: KEZAD Hotel & Mall - Al Rahayel
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of a mixed-use hospitality and commercial development within the Al Rahayel area of Abu Dhabi, comprising the KEZAD Hotel and an adjoining mall. The development aims to serve the growing business and industrial community in the KEZAD zone by creating a modern, integrated business and leisure destination.

The total plot area spans 38,431 square meters, with a built-up area of 29,200 square meters. The architectural concept features a simple yet iconic form, with an emphasis on circulation, visibility, and natural light. The hotel is designed with luxury serviced apartments, offering privacy while maintaining strategic connectivity to the business and retail components of the project.

A standout design feature is the bridge connection at the first floor, linking the hotel and mall. This allows seamless movement between the commercial center and hospitality areas while ensuring privacy for hotel guests. The roof of the business center is envisioned as a leisure area, providing additional recreational amenities without compromising the exclusivity of the hotel residences.

KEZAD Hotel & Mall - Al Rahayel is a greenfield hotel project in Abu Dhabi, valued at USD 100.0 million, at concept. Developed by Kezad Group (Khalifa Economic Zones Abu Dhabi Group) (Formerly Kizad). No consultant recorded. No contractor appointed. Completion date not recorded in the source workbook.

With its modern architectural lines, functional interiors, and a community-first design approach, each apartment is crafted to maximize comfort, natural light, and efficient space utilization. Strategically positioned within Dubai Sports City, residents enjoy seamless access to green parks, walking tracks, and world-class sports facilities, making Sartoria Residences a standout lifestyle destination. projects.name: Mirasol Phase II - Al Raha Island
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of a resort-inspired residential community on Mina, Ras Al Khaimah’s premium waterfront destination, designed to offer contemporary and elevated living experiences. Mirasol Phase II comprises 280 units across visually distinct and architecturally striking buildings, making it one of the most prominent and well-connected apartment complexes within the North Harbour neighbourhood of Raha Island.

Upon completion, the development will feature three fully integrated residential communities, including two low-rise apartment buildings and elegant duplexes offering harbour views. Mirasol Phase II offers a range of amenities designed to enhance lifestyle and wellness. These include an Oasis Pool with panoramic views of the Arabian Gulf, a children’s play area with splash pool, sunken beds for sun lounging, a lounge and juice bar, and designated areas for remote working. Residents can enjoy an open-air cinema for al fresco movie nights under the stars.

The development also features a signature in-house restaurant with dishes curated by Michelin-starred Chef Vicente Torres. For wellness enthusiasts, Mirasol Phase II provides an indoor yoga studio, a state-of-the-art fitness centre with modern equipment, sauna and steam rooms, and a shaded jogging track.

Its strategic location offers proximity to world-class hotel resorts, including the Four Seasons Resort and Spa, Nikki Beach, Anantara, and InterContinental hotels, providing residents seamless access to leisure and luxury experiences.

Mirasol Phase II - Al Raha Island is a greenfield high rise (15+) project in Ras Al Khaimah, valued at USD 100.0 million, at design. Developed by Rak Properties (Pjsc). Lead consultant T A Design Studio Dxb. No contractor appointed. Completion date not recorded in the source workbook.

projects.name: Laborer Market - Muhaisanah 2
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of a laborer market, covering an area of 9,292 square meters within the industrial zones of Muhaisanah 2.

The project will offer comprehensive shopping facilities, including sections for ready-to-eat food, fruit, and vegetable vendors, meat and fish markets, general retail shops, and clothing outlets, along with barber shops, sewing services, and ticket centers. Moreover, the products and goods will be offered at prices suitable for workers while adhering to all health, safety, and food safety standards set by Dubai Municipality.

projects.name: Sobha SkyParks

The project involves the construction of Sobha SkyParks, a 109-storey residential skyscraper rising to a height of 450 metres along Sheikh Zayed Road in Dubai. Once completed, it will be among the five tallest towers in the UAE and the tallest in Sobha Realty’s portfolio.


The tower will comprise 684 premium residences and be divided into five interconnected sub-towers, offering panoramic views of Sheikh Zayed Road, Palm Jumeirah, the Arabian Gulf, and Downtown Dubai.


Designed as a vertical community, Sobha SkyParks will feature four sky parks at different levels, incorporating gardens, infinity pools, wellness zones, and relaxation decks. Residents will also enjoy a variety of themed zones, including adventure areas with cinemas, family pools, and play spaces; active lifestyle zones with jogging tracks, yoga decks, and calisthenics gyms; and luxury zones featuring jacuzzis, sky lounges, and high-altitude leisure facilities nearly 375 metres above ground.


Its prime location on Sheikh Zayed Road ensures seamless connectivity across Dubai, with close proximity to key destinations such as Business Bay, Downtown Dubai, DIFC, Dubai Design District, Jumeirah Beach, and Dubai International Airport. Combining iconic architecture, elevated lifestyle amenities, and strategic accessibility, Sobha SkyParks represents a new benchmark in vertical living within Dubai’s evolving skyline.

projects.name: Azizi Milan

The project involves the construction of Azizi Milan, a 40,350,000 sqft mixed-use community master-planned along Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road in Dubai. At its heart will be 81,200 residences spread across a carefully graduated skyline—from low- and mid-rise buildings of 25–35 stories to two landmark towers rising up to 70 stories. Each building will feature panoramic glass elevators and a privately landscaped rooftop garden, with every roof, podium, and surrounding plaza planted with exotic trees and flowering plants. Infinity pools, water fountains, and sports courts will be interwoven throughout lush public and private green spaces, creating a seamless connection between the built environment and nature.

Azizi Milan will also encompass 800 hotel keys within luxury hospitality components, a sprawling retail mall, and a signature network of pedestrian-only fashion streets dedicated to distinct realms such as perfumery, cosmetics, bags, and apparel. These fashion boulevards will be lined with high-end boutiques, cafés, fine-dining venues, and nightlife venues, establishing the community as the region’s new fashion capital. Complementing these offerings are office precincts, essential lifestyle facilities—including schools, nurseries, mosques, and wellness centers—and a comprehensive sustainability framework. Designed as a zero-carbon development, Azizi Milan will offset emissions through certified mangrove, forest, and solar projects, while incorporating green-building standards in every structure.

projects.name: Disneyland Theme Park - Yas Island
projects.description: The project involves the construction of a Disney theme park on Yas Island, Abu Dhabi. This will be the first Disney park in the Middle East and the seventh in the world. The theme park is expected to be the most technologically advanced and interactive in Disney’s portfolio. It will feature a central castle inspired by crystal formations and local culture, alongside immersive rides and attractions. The park is part of Disney’s USD 60 billion investment in its parks and experiences segment. Disney is introducing water into the design of its iconic castle for the first time, with Abu Dhabi’s version inspired by the sea, nature, and subtle touches from Moana, Elsa, and Anna. This one-of-a-kind creation, unlike any castle before it, will serve as the park’s signature landmark and distinguish it from Disney’s other global destinations. projects.name: Omoria Hotel Residences - Dubai Islands
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of Omoria Hotel Residences on the exclusive Dubai Islands. This development comprises a basement floor, a ground floor, and 7 additional floors, which offer a luxurious combination of hotel-style living and residential comfort, catering to those who desire sophistication and convenience. Designed to provide both the privacy of home and the services of a five-star hotel, the residences offer a premium living experience.

Each unit within Omoria Hotel Residences is meticulously designed with contemporary interiors, spacious layouts, and high-end finishes. Residents will enjoy a range of hotel-style amenities, including concierge services, housekeeping, a fitness center, wellness spa, and gourmet dining options, ensuring that everyday living is effortless and indulgent.

The development is located in a prime spot on the Dubai Islands, providing residents with easy access to pristine beaches, upscale retail outlets, dining experiences, and top attractions such as Downtown Dubai and Dubai Marina. Whether for short-term stays or long-term residence, Omoria Hotel Residences offers an unparalleled lifestyle.

Additionally, the development features an infinity swimming pool with a view of the water, state-of-the-art fitness centers, spas, and beautifully landscaped gardens. Exclusive beach access ensures a tranquil and private escape from the city bustle. Concierge services and 24-hour security provide peace of mind, making this an ideal living space for those seeking both luxury and convenience.

Omoria Hotel Residences also presents a prime investment opportunity in one of Dubai’s most sought-after locations, combining luxury with exceptional services and an outstanding location.

Omoria Hotel Residences - Dubai Islands is a greenfield hotel apartments project in Dubai, valued at USD 50.0 million, at under construction (7.0 percent complete). Developed by Innovate Living. Lead consultant Engineering Consortium Consulting Engineers,Innovate Project Development Llc. No contractor appointed. Completion date not recorded in the source workbook.

projects.name: The Island - Umm Suqeim 2
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of a beachfront development spread over 3.5 million square meters for touristic and leisure services.

It will include Las Vegas hotel brands such as, MGM, Bellagio and Aria containing 1,000 hotel rooms and apartments, 10 villas with a built-up area of 105,218 square meters as well as luxurious restaurants and cafés and a theatre.

The island will also include indoor and outdoor swimming pools, business person lounge, water fountains and artificial waterfalls. 'Dubai Spher', which is an entertainment tower situated in the middle of the island, it rises to a distance of 110 meters and can accommodate about 300 seats for guests to enable them to see the sound and light displays in 3D with special effects.

The theatre will have a seating capacity of 800 and occupy an area of 80,000 square feet. It will host shows organized by MGM, conferences, festivals and weddings.

The beach club at the island will offer a number of maritime leisure services and activities to guests and visitors. Water shows will be organized in the evenings, and the club and its five-star facilities are also capable of hosting special honouring ceremonies.

The island will be surrounded by a corniche spanning an area of 1.2km that will include cafés, restaurants and retail stores. The ‘Cave of Wonders’, occupying 124,000 square feet of space, will focus on providing entertainment for children and their families through sports and games that cater to different age groups.

The Island - Umm Suqeim 2 is a greenfield mega urban development project in Dubai, valued at USD 1200.0 million, at under construction. projects.name: Granada - Phase 2 - Bloom Living
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of the second phase of Granada, a premium low-rise residential apartment community located within a larger master-planned development in Zayed City, Abu Dhabi. Spanning eight four-story buildings, this phase is designed around the principles of traditional Mediterranean architecture blended with modern comfort, offering a fully integrated and inclusive living experience.

Granada 2 is the ninth phase within the broader community, offering 458 modern apartments that range from compact studios to spacious three-bedroom units. It offers a diverse range of units including studios, one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments, all featuring modern finishes, high ceilings, and open floor plans. Each apartment is thoughtfully designed with large windows that invite abundant natural light, creating bright and airy interiors. Generous balconies and spacious living areas further enhance the residential experience.

The community caters to multi-generational living, offering residents direct access to an array of high-quality amenities. These include fully equipped fitness centers, cafés, lounge spaces, kids' play areas, shaded playgrounds, and swimming pools. Communal zones throughout Granada are designed with landscaped gardens, decorative façades, and wide courtyards, providing relaxing and luxurious outdoor environments.

In addition to its diverse range of units, Granada 2 emphasizes lifestyle-enhancing amenities. Residents will have access to two fully equipped gyms, two large swimming pools, landscaped gardens, children’s play areas, a dedicated prayer room, secure basement parking, and a dedicated sports track promoting an active and connected way of life.

 

Granada - Phase 2 - Bloom Living is a greenfield mid rise (4 - 14) project in Abu Dhabi, valued at USD 80.0 million, at design. Developed by Bloom Holding Pjsc. No consultant recorded. No contractor appointed. Completion date not recorded in the source workbook.

projects.name: Sharjah Creative Quarter (SCQ)
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of the Sharjah Creative Quarter (SCQ), a landmark development designed to serve as a distinguished destination for artists, creatives, and intellectuals from both within and outside the country. Strategically located in Sharjah’s educational and innovation hub, the SCQ aims to foster a dynamic community of innovators, providing a platform for talent showcasing and cultural exchange. The development will feature a range of integrated buildings, including cultural spaces, prototyping facilities, and research areas, creating a vibrant ecosystem for creativity and collaboration.

Key elements of the SCQ include:

  • Sheikha Jawaher Bint Mohammed Al Qasimi Collection: A museum showcasing a curated selection of art and historical artifacts from Her Highness Sheikha Jawaher bint Mohammed Al Qasimi's personal collection.
  • Qasimi Archives: Honoring the legacy of Sheikh Khalid Al Qasimi and inspiring the next generation of fashion designers.
  • Sharjah Fashion Lab: Provides local designers with world-class expertise and technological innovation to develop fashion prototypes and products.
  • Irthi Museum: A museum that promotes and contemporizes Emirati and regional crafts while empowering traditional craftswomen.
  • Sharjah Design Centre: A newly established facility offering mastery in various design disciplines such as woodwork, ceramics, metalwork, textiles, and fine jewelry.
  • L’ÉCOLE, School of Jewelry Arts: The first of its kind in Sharjah and the second in the Middle East, offering courses and talks on the culture of jewelry arts.

The SCQ emphasizes sustainability and integrates with its surrounding landscape. The development will incorporate green spaces, interconnected buildings, and essential amenities such as cafes, restaurants, and co-working areas, ensuring a stimulating environment for all who visit and engage with the space. The project will prioritize eco-friendly materials like rammed earth to minimize its environmental impact.

This visionary development will become a cultural and innovation hub for both local and international communities.

Sharjah Creative Quarter (SCQ) is a greenfield landmark, museum & galleries project in Sharjah, valued at USD 300.0 million, at design. Developed by Sharjah Art Foundation,Beeah Tandeef. Lead consultant Taller De Arquitectuta Y Obras (Tao),Methanoia. No contractor appointed. Completion date not recorded in the source workbook.

The project involves the construction of King’s College School Wimbledon – Abu Dhabi Campus, a new premium K–12 British school on Fahid Island. Scheduled to open for the 2028–2029 academic year, the campus is being planned as a super-premium educational facility that will accommodate up to 2,220 students aged 3 to 18.

Spanning 50,000 square metres, the campus will offer advanced educational infrastructure, top-tier sports facilities, and dedicated wellness spaces. The school will reflect the educational standards of the renowned King’s College School Wimbledon in London, incorporating a holistic approach that combines academic excellence with character development and co-curricular enrichment. The curriculum will provide pathways to both UK and IB qualifications at the sixth form level.

The campus is strategically located within the 2.7 million square metre master-planned community of Fahid Island, a wellness-centric coastal destination featuring over 6,000 luxury homes, a 10km fitness corridor, beaches, and a waterfront promenade.

Bonds Avenue Residences, offers a perfect blend of luxury and sophistication in the heart of Dubai Islands. This exclusive residential community features a selection of elegant 1-, 2-, and 3-bedroom apartments, lavish 4-bedroom penthouses, and sophisticated 3-bedroom townhouses.

The project is designed to redefine beachfront living through architectural excellence and sustainable design. Bonds Avenue will offer approximately 75 premium units surrounded by landscaped courtyards, leisure amenities, and community facilities, tailored for both modern families and urban professionals.

The development will integrate smart home technologies, energy-efficient systems, and pedestrian-friendly design principles. These features, along with lush green spaces and smart water management systems, reflect the developer’s commitment to eco-conscious, wellness-focused living.

Residents will have access to a wide range of upscale amenities, including a Jacuzzi, barbecue facilities, a children's playground, a children's pool, a concierge service, a gym, an infinity pool, a jogging track, landscaped gardens, a miniature golf course, a padel tennis court, private pools, a sauna, and yoga and meditation areas—creating a complete lifestyle destination within the community.

projects.name: Bloom Seville - Phase 5 - Bloom Living

The project involves the construction of residential development named Seville, the 5th phase of Bloom Living. The project introduces a range of residential options, including seven-bedroom mansions, three to six-bedroom villas, and two to three-bedroom townhouses. The project boasts over 200 villas, more than 200 townhouses, and a total of over 400 residential units with premium lakeside vistas and ample living space, alongside access to top-tier amenities within the community.

Crafted to promote indoor-outdoor living, the thoughtfully designed homes feature modern, elegant finishes, lofty ceilings, and expansive windows offering tranquil lake views, imbuing each space with a bright, airy ambiance suffused with natural light. Seville's communal areas are characterized by open, inviting layouts, comprising verdant gardens and spacious courtyards, perfect for leisurely pursuits.

Seville is designed to accommodate residents of all ages and lifestyles, making it a truly inclusive, multi-generational locale. Its fully equipped community centers offer an array of amenities, including fitness facilities, cafes, lounges, children's play areas, swimming pools, and shaded playgrounds.

The island will feature a combination of high-end hotels and branded residences within a broader community offering beachfront and marina-style living. Amenities will include marinas, beach clubs, a wellness center, retail and leisure facilities, wholefood markets, and beautifully landscaped boulevards. 

Raha Island will epitomize luxury island living, ideal for those seeking the ultimate island lifestyle. It will boast a breathtaking landscape, including over 2.5 kilometers of accessible public beaches, offering an ideal starting point for water sports and adventures, or simply a relaxed day on the water. A complimentary water transit system will connect the entire community, allowing residents and visitors to explore local attractions or travel to other Emirates via hydrofoil.

Luxury shopping will be available at the retail area, with exclusive brands and personalized services for Raha Island's residents. People can enjoy a variety of food and drink options at outdoor seating areas with beautiful views of the calm waters. This mix of city waterfront living and stylish beach life will create a unique community atmosphere.

projects.name: Akala Hotel & Residences by Arada
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of Akala Hotel & Residences, a luxury wellness-focused mixed-use development comprising two 50 floors -220-metre towers located in Za'abeel 2, Bur Dubai. The project is branded as the world’s first 'precision wellness' destination, integrating advanced medical diagnostics, performance therapies, and hospitality under one concept.

The development features 534 branded residential units ranging from one-bedroom apartments to a multi-level penthouse known as The Observatory, with panoramic views of the Burj Khalifa. The two towers—Akala Hotel Tower 1 and Akala Residences Tower 2—share a podium that houses a range of wellness and clinical amenities. These include a high-performance fitness centre, indoor lap pool, group training studios, private training pods, spa suites, and wellness studios for yoga, meditation, and sensory therapies.

A key feature is a full-floor medical wellness clinic operated by Everwell, offering advanced treatments such as stem cell and exosome therapy, PRP, gut biome correction, osteopathy, chiropractic, and more. Residents benefit from personalised wellness services including lifestyle and nutrition programs, vitamin C-infused showers, soundproofed rooms, circadian lighting, air and water purification systems, and smart home integrations.

Amenities include multiple swimming pools, a cinema, yoga areas, spas, saunas, amphitheatre, wellness and lifestyle concierge services, in-home treatments, curated dining based on genetic profiling, and more. Outdoor spaces feature a temperature-controlled L-shaped pool deck, children’s pool, and pool bar with nutrient-rich refreshments. The architectural design incorporates biophilic elements and sustainability innovations, achieving LEED Gold and WELL Silver precertifications.

Aimed at high-net-worth individuals, Akala represents a new model of living where residential comfort, preventative healthcare, and personalised wellness converge. Future expansions of the Akala brand are planned across key global cities in the Middle East, Europe, and Australia.

Akala Hotel & Residences by Arada is a greenfield hotel apartments project in Dubai, valued at USD 1361.3 million, at design. Developed by Arada. Lead consultant Keo International Consultants Wll,Keo International Consultants Wll. No contractor appointed. Completion date not recorded in the source workbook.

Residents can enjoy landscaped surroundings, a shimmering pool, children’s play zones, a Technogym-equipped fitness center, concierge services, and EV charging stations, all enhancing a lifestyle of comfort and luxury.

The residential options include studios, 1-bedroom apartments, 1-bedroom apartments with a pool, 2-bedroom apartments with a pool, 3-bedroom apartments with a pool, and 4-bedroom apartments with a pool.

The property offers panoramic views of iconic Dubai landmarks, including the Burj Khalifa, Dubai Canal, Jumeirah Beach, and the sea. Residents of this complex will enjoy over 40 world-class amenities such as landscaped gardens, a kids' outdoor pool, an outdoor swimming pool, a multipurpose hall, a yoga court, dining options, jogging trails, a sports court, a well-equipped gym and fitness center, covered parking and concierge service. The complex also ensures round-the-clock security and CCTV surveillance. With high-end finishes, fully furnished options featuring Italian Dolce Vita furniture, and a premier helipad for sky taxis and helicopters, it delivers a truly luxurious lifestyle.

Strategically located in Business Bay, the Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary is a short 6-minute drive away, while the Dubai Mall is conveniently situated just 9 minutes away. Dubai International Airport can be reached in approximately fifteen minutes, and the iconic Burj Khalifa is a mere 10-minute drive away. Access to Palm Jumeirah takes approximately 22 minutes by car. It also provides convenient access to Sheikh Zayed Road and the metro station.

Each unit boasts sun-filled terraces, providing tranquil outdoor spaces for relaxation, with private plunge pools available on the terraces of one- and three-bedroom apartments.

The project also boasts a wide range of top-tier amenities designed to enrich the lifestyle of its residents, including a welcoming lobby, modern co-working spaces, a rooftop swimming pool with cabanas and sunken loungers, outdoor seating areas, changing rooms, a sauna, a hammam, an outdoor cinema, a fully-equipped gym, a zen garden with a waterfall, an urban farm, a pizzeria and BBQ area, LEOS Davinci Art Academy, a dance studio, and a boxing academy. Additionally, concierge services are accessible via the LEOS app, and the development is secured with 24-hour security.

Strategically located off Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road in Dubailand, which spans three million square feet, Weybridge Gardens 3, The Alps offers residents a contemporary urban lifestyle surrounded by a vibrant mix of districts and attractions. The area is home to theme parks, shopping malls, residential communities, top-tier education, and medical facilities, with the future Dubai Metro blue line.

Designed to meet the rising demand for premium urban living, the residential tower will house approximately 350 apartments, comprising studios, one-, two-, and three-bedroom units. All apartments will offer panoramic views of Ras Al Khaimah. The development aims to foster a self-contained, smart-living environment with integrated amenities, including a private swimming pool, gym, padel courts, a multi-purpose hall, and various other facilities designed to support a modern lifestyle.

The development will be part of a broader mixed-use environment that includes office, retail, hospitality, and entertainment offerings—positioning RAK Central as a holistic destination for living, working, and leisure.

projects.name: Crypto Tower - Jumeirah Lakes Towers
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of a 17-storey 'Crypto Tower' in Jumeirah Lakes Towers, Dubai, designed to showcase the application of blockchain technology in tenant interactions and operations. Spanning 150,000 sq ft of leasable space, the tower will cater to blockchain, decentralized finance, and Web3 companies. It will feature nine floors of office spaces tailored for crypto startups and established businesses, three floors dedicated to blockchain incubators, venture capital firms, and investment companies, and one floor focused on artificial intelligence innovation.

In addition, the development will include a 10,000-square-foot indoor event space, complemented by a 3,500-square-foot outdoor area for crypto and blockchain events. The top three floors will house an exclusive 30,000-square-foot crypto club, providing premium networking and leisure amenities, designed to foster high-level collaboration and networking within the blockchain community.

The Crypto Tower will also offer high-end features such as an NFT art gallery, a gold bullion shop, an exotic car dealership, and a dedicated vault storage area providing 5,000 square feet of secure space for valuables, including gold, cash, and cold wallets. This multifunctional development is set to set a new standard for integrating technology, finance, and lifestyle into one space, creating a seamless and secure environment for the world’s leading crypto players.

projects.name: Al Jazira Club Stadium – Zayed City
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of the new Al Jazira Club Stadium in Zayed City, Abu Dhabi, as part of a 136-acre integrated sports, leisure, and entertainment destination. The development aligns with the Abu Dhabi Economic Vision 2030, aiming to provide world-class athletic infrastructure and community facilities.


The main stadium will feature an initial seating capacity of 24,000, expandable to 30,000, with fully air-conditioned seating and a retractable pitch that can slide out of the main arena. Designed for versatility, the arena can host between 5,000 and 25,000 spectators and will include an operable roof, allowing it to accommodate diverse events such as football tournaments, concerts, conventions, and rugby matches.


Surrounding the main stadium, the master plan integrates a variety of facilities, including training and instructional centers, a tennis academy, a football school, and a multi-purpose sports and leisure club. The Al Jazira Training Facilities will host two full-sized training fields, 40 player residences, and offices for professional teams, while the Youth Academy will include six full-sized fields and supporting infrastructure.


The Al Jazira Sport & Leisure Club will feature fitness areas, pools, an indoor sports hall, a gravity center, commercial spaces, and a conference hall. The Tennis Academy will comprise 16 world-class courts, eight of which will include spectator seating and shading. The Football School will offer indoor and outdoor fields, a pro shop, and 5-a-side pitches.


Complementing the sports infrastructure is a 15-acre community park with a children’s play area, field hockey pitch, sand volleyball courts, cycling and running tracks, and landscaped open spaces. The project will also include restaurants and lounges that remain accessible outside of event times, enhancing its appeal as a year-round destination for residents and visitors alike.

Al Jazira Club Stadium – Zayed City is a greenfield stadium project in Abu Dhabi, valued at USD 750.0 million, at design. The developer is not yet recorded. No consultant recorded. No contractor appointed. Completion date not recorded in the source workbook.

Buyers can choose from one-bedroom apartments to luxurious five-bedroom homes, including rooftop penthouses with pools that provide breathtaking views.

projects.name: Danah Bay Residential Tower (Phase 3)

The project involves the construction of a residential tower within Danah Bay. The project stands at 89 meters with a distinctive wavy, glazed facade, offering 123 units ranging from one to four-bedroom apartments and luxurious penthouses, providing residents with direct beach access and proximity to the upscale Grand Millennium resort. Spanning 126,000 square feet (11,700 square meters) prioritizes sea views and luxurious experiences for its residents. With its tapering structure towards the water, the tower ensures that even the rear units maintain stunning views. Catering to diverse lifestyle needs, it offers a variety of living spaces from studio apartments to penthouses.

At the ground level, two lavish motor courts welcome residents and visitors with water features, open spaces, and valet service, elevating the sense of luxury. Tall ceilings on the ground floor contribute to the feeling of spaciousness and luxury throughout. Each apartment is meticulously designed to complement residents' lifestyles, featuring well-thought-out living spaces, additional storage, and walk-in closets. Balconies provide panoramic views of the Arabian Gulf, the community, the beach, and the expansive Ras Al Khaimah skyline, offering an immersive living experience.

The tower's unique external curved design not only leaves a distinctive mark on the exterior but also adds character to the interiors, enhancing the overall ambiance of the living spaces. projects.name: Park Gate 2 - Dubai Hills Estate

Developed by Emaar Properties, this second phase follows the successful launch of its predecessor and brings a refined living experience through a seamless blend of architectural sophistication and natural serenity. Each of the 10 villas features 4 or 5 bedrooms and is spread across ground plus two floors (G+2). These homes are thoughtfully designed with expansive living areas, floor-to-ceiling windows for abundant natural light, and rooftop garden terraces offering panoramic views of Dubai’s skyline, including the iconic Burj Khalifa. The residences exhibit high-end interiors with soft textures, neutral palettes, and elegant finishes that reflect a sophisticated yet comfortable modern lifestyle. Park Gate 2 offers a complete luxury community experience with a wide range of premium amenities including a fully equipped gymnasium, temperature-controlled infinity pool, wellness facilities, and beach access. The development also incorporates green open spaces with jogging trails, landscaped pocket parks, and walking paths, creating a nature-rich environment that encourages an active and serene lifestyle. Residents also benefit from thoughtfully integrated lifestyle features such as children’s play areas, multi-purpose lounges, basketball and tennis courts, amusement areas, dining outlets, supermarkets, and retail outlets. These amenities ensure a well-rounded, community-focused environment within one of Dubai’s most desirable residential districts. Solar-powered sun loungers and a customized beauty bar with unique skincare products tailored to individual needs

The project with its impressive views of the Business Bay neighborhood and each unit overlooking the serene waters of the Dubai Canal, will feature opulent townhouses at the podium level, providing residents with expansive living and garden spaces.

Inspired by the opal, the interior design incorporates distinctive cracks that produce a multi-color reflective effect, giving the spaces a luminous and vibrant appearance. Circular elements within the design evoke a celestial ambiance.

projects.name: Brabus Island
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of Brabus Island, a luxury branded residential development by BRABUS. Located on a private island in the upscale Al Seef District of Abu Dhabi, the development spans approximately 100,000 square meters and is set to redefine high-end living in the UAE capital.

Brabus Island will feature a total of 450 luxury residences, comprising 350 high-rise apartments and 100 bespoke waterfront villas. The apartments are distributed across four residential towers and offer two- to four-bedroom layouts, ranging from 1,100 to 5,000 square feet. Each apartment is crafted to reflect BRABUS’s signature design identity, with interiors available in modular themes such as Black & Bold, White Bliss, and Gray Haven. Much like the brand’s high-performance vehicles, the residences offer options for customization with premium materials and high-end finishes.

The single-family villas, all positioned on either beachfront or waterfront plots, emphasize privacy and exclusivity. These bespoke homes are designed to maximize views and access to the island’s tranquil environment. Both apartment and villa residents will benefit from direct waterfront access and a wide array of lifestyle amenities tailored for luxury living.

The architectural vision of Brabus Island emphasizes sleek lines, performance-inspired design, and refined modernity. The residences feature floor-to-ceiling windows that frame panoramic views of the Arabian Gulf, Yas Island, and Saadiyat Island. Each home comes fully finished and ready for occupancy, with interiors showcasing natural marble, sintered stone, and wood finishes. Standard features include private balconies or terraces, built-in kitchen appliances, smart home automation, central air conditioning, built-in wardrobes, and fiber-optic high-speed internet connectivity.

In addition to premium living spaces, Brabus Island delivers a world-class residential lifestyle. Amenities include multiple swimming pools for adults and children, a fully equipped gym and health club, sauna and steam rooms, an outdoor jacuzzi, and a private padel court. The development also includes indoor and outdoor kids’ play areas, BBQ zones, and dedicated social lounges. Concierge services and 24/7 security provide residents with convenience, privacy, and peace of mind.

Brabus Island is a greenfield mega urban development project in Abu Dhabi, valued at USD 1000.0 million, at concept. Developed by Brabus Gmbh,Reportage Real Estate Llc,Abu Dhabi Municipality - Roads Department. No consultant recorded. No contractor appointed. Completion date not recorded in the source workbook.

projects.name: Shams Studios - Sharjah Media City

The project involves the construction of Shams Studios, a state-of-the-art media production facility in Sharjah Media City. The complex will span a total area of 38,136 square meters and include five cutting-edge studios, each covering 1,710 square meters. The studios are designed to meet the diverse needs of film and media production, offering an advanced infrastructure that includes fully integrated post-production facilities with editing suites, visual effects technologies, and sound processing rooms. These features will provide a seamless, world-class production experience for media professionals.

In addition to the studios, the project will feature collaborative workspaces for creatives, office spaces for production companies, and modern meeting rooms, creating a dynamic environment for industry professionals to collaborate and innovate. The development will also include 20 versatile creative units available for both short-term rentals and long-term leases, supporting a range of production needs.

Furthermore, a dedicated hotel building and exclusive suites for actors and production teams will provide privacy and comfort, ensuring an optimal working environment. Recreational facilities will be integrated into the complex to foster creativity and innovation. This strategic development will further enhance Sharjah’s readiness to host major media productions, reinforcing its position as a leading regional and global media production hub.

projects.name: Gate Eleven Residences by Amwaj
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of Gate Eleven Residences, a premium residential development located in District 11, Meydan, along Al Ain Road in Dubai. The development features four adjacent buildings, each comprising seven storeys with an additional basement level, thoughtfully designed to offer uninterrupted views of surrounding lagoons and green spaces.

Gate Eleven comprises a curated selection of elegant one- and two-bedroom apartments. Each unit has been designed to cater to both individuals and families, with spacious layouts, luxurious finishes, and cutting-edge smart home systems that allow residents to control lighting, climate, and security remotely.

Beyond the private units, the project emphasizes community living. It includes a wide range of lifestyle and wellness amenities such as an infinity pool, a fully equipped gym, a sauna, a boxing studio, yoga studio, kids' play area, and a lobby lounge. Additional facilities include a restaurant, wellness centre, pharmacy, market, and table tennis area—enhancing both convenience and quality of life.

Strategically positioned just minutes from Downtown Dubai, The Dubai Mall, and Dubai International Airport, with direct connectivity to Al Ain Road, Gate Eleven provides a tranquil, accessible living experience within one of the most desirable neighborhoods in Dubai.

Aimed at redefining the ultra-luxury living standard, the development integrates timeless design, sustainability, and smart technologies to create a vibrant residential environment that fosters wellness, social connection, and long-term investment value.

projects.name: Dubai Square Mall - Dubai Creek Harbor
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of the largest malls in the world namely, Dubai Square. The project will spread over an area of 2.6-million square meters and is set to be the iconic retail, hospitality and residential district for the future.

The project will be a technology-driven retail destination in Dubai Creek Harbor. The mall will offer extensive retail choices, unique dining concepts, and world-class leisure attractions. The technological innovation offer ‘omnichannel retailing’. It enables the consumer to shop predominantly via mobiles or at a retail store. It not only drives in-store retail but also the online engagement of brands with customers. With its location in Dubai Creek Harbour, and by serving as the closest

Dubai square will have 750,000 square meters of gross floor retail space, which is nearly more than twice the gross leasable area of The Dubai Mall. The project will offer around 1,500 hotel rooms and over 1,000 apartment units.

It is spread across three levels, each presenting a unique set of experiences to the customer. The mall will include dedicated streets, plazas, and a glass roof, skylights and shopfront windows which will give it an impression of an indoor city. It will have industrial themed sections as well as traditional Arabic architecture in other parts. Along with that, a Chinese city named Chinatown is planned for the development. Parks, patches of green and lush landscaping will provide a natural balance to state-of-the-art facilities. Special LED technology is set to drive impactful and interactive backdrops and delight customers throughout their journey. The shopping center will act as a key feature of the Dubai Creek Harbor development. It will also feature an Art District.

The ground floor will have an event arena like celebrity performances, concerts and theatre shows in a futuristic entertainment arena with 3D projection mapping, theatrical sound and lighting and a broad spectrum of event spaces on streets and alleys.

The first floor has a magnificent four-lane boulevard lined with luxury retail, dining and leisure outlets. Dubai Square will offer special VIP dressing rooms, smart fitting rooms with interactive mirrors, curated private fashion collections, personalized AI recommendations, 3D printed clothing and accessories, fashion museums and more.

The second floor will have an activities arena, 'Ice Adventure', as well as a cutting-edge Cineplex, a waterpark, sports arena, supermarket and the metro link.

Dubai Square will be linked directly to the Dubai Creek Tower through a cutting-edge underground extension. It will open at a plaza at the base of the Tower. The Plaza is a clock-shaped haven of landscaping, palm trees and water features sprawling across half a kilometer of land.

The F&B section is one of the unique attraction to the visitors. Specially designed apps will be developed for ordering food and beverage. They provide personalized dining recommendations and 3D-printed food delicacies. Dubai Square will also have live cooking stations, street vendors, festive pop-up markets, grab-and-go F&B offerings and an organic market.

It will have a free metro-link from the airport will transport. This will help the mall to attract around five or six million transiting passengers through Dubai International Airport. It will have a dedicated metro hub namely, Grand Central Station located within the retail complex.

Dubai Square Mall - Dubai Creek Harbor is a greenfield shopping mall project in Dubai, valued at USD 2700.0 million, at under construction (3.0 percent complete). Developed by Emaar Properties Pjsc,Dubai Holding. Lead consultant Dp Architects Pte Ltd. (Dubai),Santiago Calatrava Sa,Arcadis Middle East (Dubai),Brewer Smith & Brewer Gulf (Bsbg); MEP consultant Holford Associates. Main contractor Dutco Balfour Beatty (Dutco Construction Co. projects.name: Four Seasons Resort and Residences - Mina Al Arab - Ras Al Khaimah
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of the Four Seasons Resort and Residences Ras Al Khaimah at Mina, a luxury beach resort and private residences as part of the expansive 400-hectare Mina master-planned waterfront development.

The resort will feature approximately 150 rooms, suites, and signature villas, along with 130 private residences. The development will offer guests and residents an unparalleled experience, with amenities such as a spa, waterfront dining, family and adult pools, tennis and basketball courts, and a fully equipped fitness center. The development will also feature wellness facilities with 10 treatment rooms and a beauty salon, as well as a complimentary Kids For All Seasons program dedicated to children and young adults. Additionally, the resort will include a dedicated marina, secluded beaches, and a grand ballroom designed for events and gatherings of all sizes.

The Four Seasons Private Residences will offer villas ranging from four to six bedrooms and luxury apartments from two to five bedrooms, all managed by Four Seasons staff, providing exceptional service and maintenance. The residences will also offer a flexible rental program for homeowners.

Located on a two-island escape with stunning views of the Arabian Gulf, private beaches, and the Hajar mountain range, the resort is set to become a premier destination just one hour from Dubai International Airport and 30 minutes from Ras Al Khaimah International Airport. The development will be strategically close to leisure attractions such as a Yacht Club, Wharf, and Boulevard, making it one of the UAE’s most sought-after destinations.

Four Seasons Resort and Residences - Mina Al Arab - Ras Al Khaimah is a greenfield resort project in Ras Al Khaimah, valued at USD 200.0 million, at design. Developed by Rak Properties (Pjsc),Four Seasons Hotels & Resorts. Lead consultant Denniston International Architects & Planners Ltd.,Denniston International Architects & Planners Ltd.,Denniston International Architects & Planners Ltd.. No contractor appointed. Completion date not recorded in the source workbook.

projects.name: LUM1NAR Tower3 - Jumeirah Village Triangle
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of LUM1NAR Tower 3, the third residential tower within a premium development by Object One Real Estate Development in Jumeirah Village Triangle. The complex consists of three towers, each rising basement level, a ground floor, 5 parking levels, and 20 residential floors, offering a selection of studios and 1-3 bedroom apartments designed for modern living.

LUM1NAR Tower 3 features thoughtfully designed residences with spacious layouts, soft color palettes, and contemporary interiors that create a warm and inviting atmosphere. The apartments are equipped with Smart Home technology, allowing residents to control various home functions seamlessly.

Residents will have access to world-class amenities, including a fully equipped gym, a yoga studio, a swimming pool with a lounge area, and a dedicated children’s pool. Additional leisure and relaxation facilities include a sauna, a children's indoor playroom, an outdoor playground, and a barbecue area for social gatherings.

The development is strategically located at the intersection of Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and Al Khail Road, providing easy access to key areas of Dubai.

LUM1NAR Tower3 - Jumeirah Village Triangle is a greenfield high rise (15+) project in Dubai, valued at USD 85.0 million, at under construction (10.0 percent complete). Developed by Nakheel (Pjsc),Object One Real Estate Development. Lead consultant Cv Tec Consulting Engineering. Main contractor Dsca Building Contracting Llc. projects.name: Bayn by ORA
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of Bayn, a visionary coastal community development located in Ghantoot, strategically positioned between Abu Dhabi and Dubai. Spanning 4.8 million square meters, Bayn is master-planned as a compact and sustainable city, blending dynamic urban living with coastal tranquility. Designed to accommodate up to 32,000 residents, the development balances low-density planning with expansive green and waterfront areas.

Key features of the development include 9,000 residential units comprising mansions, villas, townhouses, and apartments. The community offers over 7 kilometers of waterfront living, including 1.2 kilometers of beachfront with Arabian Gulf views, a marina, lagoon areas, a beach town, and a business park. At its heart lies a 65,000-square-meter business park, complemented by integrated schools, nurseries, retail outlets, healthcare services, wellness amenities, and a 204-berth marina. A 200-key 5-star resort and a 100,000-square-meter sports club further enhance the lifestyle offering.

Approximately 55% of the land is allocated to open spaces, including one million square meters of public parks, landscaped greenways, outdoor activity zones, and a 33-kilometer network of pedestrian, cycling, and running trails linking vibrant hubs like the marina promenade to quieter wellness-focused zones. These open spaces also feature gyms, padel courts, BBQ areas, and playgrounds to encourage community engagement and outdoor living.

Bayn integrates smart, sustainable infrastructure, including solar-powered energy systems, native landscaping for efficient water use, smart waste and water management, and building designs that maximize natural light and airflow. The community’s transportation within the masterplan is based on a 100% eco-friendly system, reinforcing Bayn’s commitment to sustainability.

In terms of urban structure, Bayn is designed with three distinct nuclei — Beach Shore Living, Resort Living, and Town Living — each offering different tiers of luxury while remaining cohesively connected. Commercial components such as a shopping mall, neighborhood parks, sports courts, and a waterpark further enrich the living experience.

Phase 1 of Bayn introduces 464 villas and townhouses across four gated clusters, offering ten distinct home typologies ranging from three to five bedrooms. 

Bayn by ORA is a greenfield mega urban development project in Abu Dhabi, valued at USD 3000.0 million, at design. Developed by Ora Developers. No consultant recorded. No contractor appointed. Completion date not recorded in the source workbook.

projects.name: Agri Hub - Dubai
projects.description: The project involves the construction of an Agri Hub located in Dubai which aims to become the world's largest eco-agritourism destination. Agri Hub is a highly attractive and activity-rich environment, which will transform Dubai into the world’s best rural visitor attraction in the world. It will provide spaces for local farmers to sell their products directly from their farms, whilst offering a new eco-friendly shopping, dining & edutainment experience for visitors. Beyond becoming a new tourism experience in the countryside and wilderness of Dubai, the project will also promote greater health, well-being, and prosperity for rural local inhabitants. The new hub will also feature a nature & heritage conservation center, an ecotourism center, an Agri-tech institute & a restorative wellness center. The conservation center will protect natural reserves & archaeological sites. The ecotourism center will offer heritage trips to ancient sites in the region, whilst also offering eco-friendly adventures such as camel riding, horse riding and desert walks. The Agri-tech institute will support farmers and provide investment opportunities for local inhabitants. The new destination will also provide health and well-being facilities with sports-focused activities. Medical facilities as well as a restorative wellness center will also promote medical tourism. Agri Hub is intertwined with a unique landscape which will be publicly accessible and offers outdoor leisure facilities, camps & lodges. The landscape is also integrated with biosaline agriculture, renewable energy production & outdoor facilities for visitors and local residents. Some of the project’s environmental features include 100% renewable energy, 100% water recycling and onsite zero waste management. The project will include 20 kilometers of dedicated cycling tracks. Agri Hub - Dubai is a greenfield mega urban development project in Dubai, valued at USD 100.0 million, at concept. Developed by Urb Planning. No consultant recorded. No contractor appointed. Completion date not recorded in the source workbook.

These include three-tiered swimming pools with over 50 meters of swimmable distance, a lagoon-style children's pool, and a swim-up seating area, enhanced by choreographed mist and lighting effects. The Portola Wellness Hub offers a snow room, Himalayan salt sauna, oxygen therapy room, cold plunge therapy, red-light therapy, and immersive relaxation lounges. Montage is located in a prime waterfront location with easy access to key districts like Downtown Dubai, Sheikh Zayed Road, and the upcoming Etihad Rail station. The development will rise to B+G+Podium+12 residential floors and include 379 units, offering a diverse mix of studios, one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments. Taiyo Residences is designed to deliver a serene, light-filled living environment that harmonizes indoor and outdoor spaces for year-round comfort. Floor-to-ceiling windows and spacious balconies offer sweeping views, while the exterior reflects a sophisticated interplay of glass, steel, and earth tones.

The development integrates a wide variety of amenities tailored for modern lifestyles. Residents will have access to indoor and outdoor gyms, a lap pool, beach pool, kids’ pool, children’s play area, an outdoor martial arts studio, and a paddle court. Social and recreational spaces include a BBQ area, gaming lounge, table tennis, billiards, and a PlayStation zone.

The project involves the construction of floating residences and a yacht in Ras Al Khaimah. The project consists of four distinct sections, first section, the 'Viking' section, will focus on designing and constructing a monumental 144-meter giga-yacht.

This giga-yacht construction will elevate Ras Al Khaimah to the elite ranks of the Netherlands, Germany, and Italy, as the fourth region globally capable of constructing giga-yachts, and the pioneering destination in the entire GCC region to achieve this feat. 

The second section of the shipyard encompasses the 'Coral Garden' area, which concentrates on constructing an unprecedented underwater living experience known as the Floating Seahorse Villas, a unique feature of The Heart of Europe project.

The third, 'Tug' section will focus on the construction of barges, supply vessels, and transportation vessels, with plans to more than double the Kleindienst Group's current fleet. Lastly, the 'Ferry' section will be dedicated to passenger transportation, fishing boats, as well as sailing and diving boats.

projects.name: Serenova - Dubai Silicon Oasis

The project involves the construction of a residential development in Dubai Silicon Oasis, covering an impressive 7,850 square meters. It will offer 222 apartments, featuring a variety of spacious layouts, including studios, one-, two-, and three-bedroom units, as well as premium two-bedroom apartments and exclusive four-bedroom penthouses.

Situated in a thriving residential and business hub, the development ensures easy access to major highways like Al Ain Road, Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, and Emirates Road. Its location near Dubai International Academic City and the forthcoming Blue Line of the Dubai Metro—complete with a nearby station—enhances its connectivity.

Each apartment will boast private balconies or spacious terraces, while the development will include a wealth of luxurious amenities. Residents will enjoy beautifully landscaped courtyards with expansive outdoor gardens, two family and children’s pools, a rooftop pool for adults, sunset terraces, a wellness court, a rooftop gym, and a fitness center. Additionally, 24/7 concierge services and top-tier security will be provided to ensure a comfortable and safe living environment.

The project involves the construction of 4 towers located in Hope Island, Al Raha, comprising a basement, ground floor, and 13 additional floors. Each tower will feature 3 elevators and 8 residential units per floor, bringing the total to 352 units across all four towers.

Each tower will include 256 two-bedroom apartments, 80 three-bedroom apartments, and 16 four-bedroom apartments.

Residents will enjoy a wide range of amenities, including air conditioning, an amphitheatre, backyard spaces, balconies, barbeque areas, covered parking, green spaces, a gym, a kids' play area, a kids' swimming pool, luxury running tracks, a sauna, a swimming pool, and a yoga lawn. The development offers direct access to an exclusive beach and ensures sea views from all units. Homes are semi-furnished with appliances and include rooftop terraces with expansive views, sun decks with outdoor swimming pools, a modern fitness center, and a chic lobby with 24-hour reception. Additional features include smart home technologies, ample visitor and covered parking, and cafés and community shops.

projects.name: Corinthia Dubai - Sheikh Zayed Road
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of a landmark luxury hotel and residential development on Sheikh Zayed Road, Dubai, near the Museum of the Future. The two-tower structure will exceed 500 metres in height, ranking among the world’s tallest buildings, and will feature a cantilevered sky lobby over 200 metres above ground. The centrepiece of the project is a 102-storey tower, making it a defining addition to Dubai’s skyline.

The development will include the Corinthia Dubai hotel, which will feature approximately 120 luxury bedrooms, branded serviced penthouses, and luxury apartments, offering refined interiors, exceptional amenities, and panoramic views of the city skyline.

Designed with a distinctive contemporary architectural style, the towers will house multiple rooftop pools, including a record-breaking outdoor sky pool over 500 metres high. Residents and guests will have access to a private members' club, lush green spaces, and the exclusive Corinthia Wellness spa, featuring state-of-the-art fitness facilities, personal training services, and innovative wellness treatments. The development will also provide a dedicated project concierge service, ensuring a seamless and elevated living experience.

The Corinthia Dubai hotel will feature approximately 120 luxury bedrooms, offering world-class hospitality services. The development will also feature five restaurants and bars with sweeping sea and city views, as well as event spaces with breathtaking backdrops of Jumeirah Beach. The ballroom and event spaces will boast stunning vistas of the beach, providing a picturesque setting for both leisure and professional gatherings.

With a total built-up area of approximately 330,000 square metres, the towers will provide stunning vistas of Sheikh Zayed Road, Burj Khalifa, Burj Al Arab, and Jumeirah Beach. The development will also include private pools for penthouses and select residences, enhancing the luxurious experience for residents. A private members’ club and lush green spaces will offer a rare sanctuary within the city, enhancing air quality and well-being.

On track to become a global landmark, the new development will showcase the five-star luxury Corinthia Dubai, alongside Corinthia-branded serviced penthouses and apartments, each offering breathtaking views and elegant interiors. Guests and residents will have exclusive access to Corinthia Wellness in a next-generation spa. With indoor and outdoor pools, cutting-edge fitness equipment, personal trainers, and a team of health and wellbeing experts, this spa experience will be unlike anything seen before in Dubai. The development will be accessed by four distinct entry points, enabling fluid movement of traffic and ensuring seamless connectivity.

This exclusive address will blend refined sophistication with tailored amenities, enriching both personal and professional lifestyles. The pièce de résistance of the development will be the world’s highest outdoor sky pool, soaring over 500 metres with panoramic 360-degree views, positioning Corinthia Dubai hotel and residences as one of the most prestigious addresses in the region.

Corinthia Dubai - Sheikh Zayed Road is a greenfield hotel project in Dubai, valued at USD 1500.0 million, at design. Developed by Corinthia Hotels Limited,Dubai General Properties. Lead consultant Atkinsrealis,Qp Design,Atkinsrealis; MEP consultant Atkinsrealis. No contractor appointed. Completion date not recorded in the source workbook.

Moreover, the products and goods will be offered at prices suitable for workers while adhering to all health, safety, and food safety standards set by Dubai Municipality.

In addition, the Municipality will oversee the hosting of recreational, social, and sporting events within these community markets, transforming them into desirable recreational destinations for laborers through collaboration with Dubai Police, a strategic partner of the Municipality in the market establishment.

projects.name: South Square - Dubai South
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of South Square, a premium residential development, located along Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road near the newly announced terminal of Al Maktoum International Airport. The development comprises four towers—two rising 9 storeys and two rising 16 storeys—offering over 550 residential units in a mix of one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments. These residences are designed with modern architecture and a focus on wellness-inspired living.

South Square is a thoughtfully planned community featuring a wide range of lifestyle and wellness amenities, including landscaped outdoor areas, scenic water features, seed farms, yoga decks, walking trails, and multi-age fitness and leisure zones. The development also includes co-working spaces, essential retail and dining outlets, and is positioned to provide residents with day-to-day convenience.

The surrounding area offers a well-developed infrastructure, including a 50,000 square-foot hypermarket, a mosque, sports courts, public parks, a petrol station, and a public bus route connecting to the Expo Metro station. The community is close to the GEMS Founders School and is home to over30,000 residents enjoying a range of gated apartment and townhouse options.

Catering to both individuals and families, the development supports healthy and connected living, with design elements promoting interaction with nature and community life.

The project involves the construction of 23 residential buildings across the Celia, Serra and Lacina clusters located at Wadi Al Safa 4.

Ghaf Woods aims to redefine indoor-outdoor living by seamlessly integrating world-class design with the surrounding natural forest environment. The trees will help reduce soil erosion, conserve water, and provide shade, keeping average temperatures 5°C cooler than the city.

In addition to the environmental benefits, Ghaf Woods will promote health and wellness for residents through walking trails, bike loops, pools, fitness facilities, gardens, and a wellness pavilion. The community will also feature a vibrant social/commercial hub called Distrikt with retail, restaurants, and gathering spaces.
